xray.title: X-ray and scan analysis
xray.description: Upload a clear photo of a chest X-ray or another scan. The AI describes what it sees and drafts a report. The AI can miss things or be wrong.
xray.reading: The AI is reading your X-ray…
tips: Photograph the film against a bright, even light, such as a window or a white screen.
Fill the frame with the scan and hold the phone parallel to it.
Check that the image is sharp before you upload it.

bone.title: Bone X-ray analysis
bone.description: Upload an X-ray of a bone or joint. The AI describes what it sees, such as a possible fracture, and drafts a report. The AI can miss things or be wrong.
bone.reading: The AI is reading your bone X-ray…
tips: Photograph the film against a bright, even light.
Include the whole bone or joint in the picture.

ecg.title: ECG analysis
ecg.description: Upload a photo or scan of an ECG printout. The AI describes the rhythm and waves it can read and drafts a report. The AI can miss things or be wrong.
ecg.reading: The AI is reading your ECG…
tips: Lay the printout flat and photograph it straight on.
Include every lead and the grid; don't crop the edges.
Use even light with no shadows across the paper.

blood.title: Blood test report
blood.description: Upload a photo of your lab report. The AI reads the values and points out the ones outside the reference range. It can misread values, so check them against the original report.
blood.reading: The AI is reading your lab report…
tips: Photograph one page at a time.
Make sure every value and its reference range is readable.
Avoid folds and shadows across the table.

prescription.title: Prescription reader
prescription.description: Upload a photo of a printed or handwritten prescription. The AI tries to read the medicines and doses. Handwriting is often misread, so always confirm with your doctor or pharmacist.
prescription.reading: The AI is reading your prescription…
tips: Photograph the whole prescription in good light.
Hold the phone steady so the handwriting is sharp.
Keep your fingers and other papers out of the picture.
